author: John Hammond
description:
This clip comes from a longer video analyzing a Linux backdoor being sold on the dark web.

One aspect that caught my attention was the focus on anti-forensics and removing traces of attacker activity, which can create additional challenges for defenders and incident responders.

Watch the full analysis here: https://youtu.be/3YB4XGy8xwE?si=pubQOr_4VfusoRrI
title: This Dark Web Linux Backdoor Erases Its Own Footprints
